$comment: The verdict of triage (→ docs/plans/26-agent-reproduce-review.md). triage.yml passes it to the action as --json-schema, and scripts/triage-apply.ts reads the same file. It sits inside single quotes on a command line there, so no text in it may contain an apostrophe (ci.test.ts holds that).

kind.description: duplicate: the same report as an open issue, linked in the comment.

size.description: l only for a new screen, tab or navigation surface with no frame in design/*.dc.html.

confidence.description: For a bug: found the cause, a plausible cause, or cannot tell from the report. not-a-bug for an idea or a duplicate.

reproduced.description: true only when the import probe output shows the symptom the reporter describes, on dev. Reading the source is never a reproduction. Reported in the comment, not required for a build.

open_questions.description: Every question the fix depends on that nothing here answered. Empty only when there is none.

fixed_on_dev_commit.description: The commit on dev that already fixes this, or the empty string.

title.description: A short title in the reporter language, keeping the Bug: or Idea: prefix.
